name: DeepDub
summary: DeepDub is an AI dubbing platform for video translation with emotion-preserving synthetic voices, enabling global video content localization.
description:
DeepDub is an AI dubbing platform for video translation with emotion-preserving synthetic voices, enabling global video content localization.

Scale up dubbing for your productions faster and more cost-efficiently than ever with the end-to-end localization platform made for voice production.

Emotion-preserving dubbing: AI voices keep the original speaker’s tone, emotion, and intent for a natural translation. Multi-language support: Translate and dub content into any major language for global audience expansion. Voice cloning: Retain the identity of the original speaker for authenticity and continuity. API access: Automate large-scale localization and dubbing workflows for enterprise-level needs.

howToUse.title: Contact DeepDub Sales
howToUse.description: Visit DeepDub and reach out via the contact form to discuss your project and get access to the platform.

howToUse.title: Onboard and Upload Video
howToUse.description: Work with the DeepDub team to onboard your project, set up access, and securely upload your source video files.

howToUse.title: Define Languages and Preferences
howToUse.description: Specify the target languages, desired tone, and any emotional requirements for dubbing. DeepDub will help configure the right AI voices.

howToUse.title: Voice Cloning & Dubbing Setup
howToUse.description: If needed, provide sample audio for voice cloning. DeepDub will set up voices to match your requirements and brand consistency.

howToUse.title: AI Dubbing and Review
howToUse.description: DeepDub’s AI transcribes, translates, and dubs the video while preserving the original speaker’s intent and emotion. Review initial outputs for feedback.

howToUse.title: Approve and Receive Deliverables
howToUse.description: Approve the final dubbed videos after your review. Receive your localized content in the required video format for global distribution.

howToUse.title: API Integration (Enterprise)
howToUse.description: For large-scale, recurring, or programmatic localization, use DeepDub’s API to automate video submission and retrieval.
